targets.TARGET_recovery_by_t2: EV>=0 within next two adjacent valids; UNAVAILABLE if incomplete
targets.TARGET_recovery_by_t3: EV>=0 within next three adjacent valids; UNAVAILABLE if incomplete

eligibility.terminal_loss: all first trade x core_state entries

gap_rule: Invalid or UNRESOLVED PRIMARY slot breaks continuity. No interpolation.
